findings.finding: The profiled body that was validated was not proven to be the body Liter dispatched.
A profile declaring an output ceiling could dispatch without a matching budget contract.
The request profile was not bound strongly enough to the endpoint and provider identity.
Anthropic thinking-budget arithmetic used an unchecked plus-one transform.

resolution: Added prepared-request byte retention and a redacted wire receipt, mandatory ceiling contracts, provider/model/endpoint fingerprint binding, and checked Anthropic arithmetic with pre-dispatch regressions.
